metric_note: Cross-flavor comparison is normalized onto the shared ArchiTexture binary evaluator (mIoU, ARI) so RWTD legacy aggregate-only summaries do not distort the page.

rwtd.label: RWTD
rwtd.description: Natural texture transitions and high-frequency boundary detection in organic scenes.

caid.label: CAID
caid.description: Architectural plan partitions and region clustering in structured manifold domains.

stld.label: STLD
stld.description: Structural and functional partitioning in diverse synthetic and real-world scenes.

cstd.label: CSTD
cstd.description: Binary region-versus-complement partitioning under the CSTD streaming benchmark.
cstd.single_flavor_note: Flip Averaged is published for CSTD, but there is no Coarse Only baseline yet.

detexture.label: DeTexture
detexture.description: Binary texture-boundary crops from ADE20K evaluated as mask_a versus mask_b under the DeTexture benchmark.
detexture.single_flavor_note: Flip Averaged is published for DeTexture ADE20K, but there is no Coarse Only baseline yet.

coarse_only.label: Coarse Only
coarse_only.summary: Average-pool the coarsest feature level once, then cluster and score the direct coarse partition.

flip_averaged.label: Flip Averaged
flip_averaged.summary: Average the coarsest features across identity, hflip, vflip, and hvflip before clustering.
